Callout.Name: Office Burglary
Callout.Message: Office broken into overnight, alarm activated late.
Callout.Advisory: No suspects on scene, window forced.

Script.Line: The alarm went off at four and nobody came until now.
The back door was forced. I have not touched the back door.
I am the one who called it in. I am the manager.

Lines.Approach: Window in and nobody about - they took their time and they took the laptops.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
